info.title: a4ai Agent
info.description: a4ai Agent API (contract 1.3). Human-readable spec: docs/AGENT_API_V2.md. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <Supabase access token>. Foreign ids return 404.

get.description: Never 403 for a not-yet-enabled institute: answers enabled=false so the UI can hide the agent.

200.description: SSE stream: `data: <AgentEvent JSON>` frames; first `session`, last `final`.

X-Agent-Request-Id.description: request_id of every event; use it to cancel

429.description: rate limit or institute token budget hit; nothing stored

get.description:
1.1 view (turns = event lists). Agent store sessions: owner only. Seed/dev fallback: the local demo
Postgres row (owner or same-institute admin, as in 1.1).

410.description: your file, but expired (1 hour); ask the agent again

schema.title: Response List Queries Agent History Queries Get

AgentEvent.description: One SSE frame of POST /agent/chat (`data: <json>`). Discriminated by `type`.

ChatRequest.title: ChatRequest
ChatRequest.description:
message is required, except with regenerate_from_seq (the stored user message is re-run).
regenerate_from_seq / edit_of_seq need session_id and are mutually exclusive (docs/AGENT_API_V2.md).

FileReady.title: FileReady
FileReady.description:
A generated file (read-only export, e.g. defaulters .xlsx). Download with GET download_path and the same
Authorization header; owner only; gone after expires_at (1 hour).

LegacySessionItem.title: LegacySessionItem
LegacySessionItem.description: Contract 1.1 shape, kept so the current UI keeps working. Deprecated: use `items`.

MetaScope.title: MetaScope
MetaScope.description:
What the caller can see. level: institute (admin) > department (HOD) > section (proctor) > classes
(teacher's own batch/subject pairs) > none (nothing assigned yet).

PendingApproval.title: PendingApproval
PendingApproval.description:
Streamed with status "pending". Stored copies (GET /messages) carry the outcome once decided, and a pending
card past expires_at is returned as "expired", so a replay never shows a stale approve button.

RateLimitDetail.title: RateLimitDetail
RateLimitDetail.description: `detail` of a 429 from POST /agent/chat (also sent as the Retry-After header). Nothing was stored.

SectionComparisonChart.description: `chart` event (kind bar) from section_comparison; only classes with data.
SectionComparisonChart.title: SectionComparisonChart

SectionComparisonTable.description:
`table` event from section_comparison: rank (ties share a rank, null = no data), class, %, held/tests,
marked/graded.
SectionComparisonTable.title: SectionComparisonTable

SessionStarted.title: SessionStarted
SessionStarted.description: First event of every /agent/chat stream (seq 0): which session this turn belongs to.
